verdict.rationale: Cactus publishes public GitHub repositories (cactus-compute/cactus, plus the needle README served from raw.githubusercontent.com), and the pricing docs describe local fine-tuning with 'the open-source package', so the core of reading the source openly is delivered. missing for 10: the specific license (e.g. MIT/Apache) is never named in the evidence, and it is unclear whether the hosted platform features are also open.
